### [`screen_row_addr`](../../../../src/screen/address_tables.asm#L6) `$7F4C`

*data*

Start address of each screen row: $4400 + 40 * row, 25 words.

- **Read by:** [`print_text`](../text/print_text.md#print_text)

### [`times8_table`](../../../../src/screen/address_tables.asm#L17) `$7F7E`

*data*

Values 8 * n for n = 0-39 (40 words). They give the byte offset of a bitmap column.
